Both describe abnormal role change within caste, with only a spelling difference.
Both target the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor but describe activation versus desensitization.
All relate to sodium channel function (inhibition, modulation, decreased conductance), which are distinct processes.
Increased vs decreased locomotion.

Both describe reduced survival, but in different organism contexts.
Increased cytotoxicity in different cell contexts (renal tubular, general, club cells).
Increased hyperplasia in different cell/tissue contexts.
Regenerative cell proliferation in different epithelia.
Increased adenomas/carcinomas in different tissues.

Both describe increased triglyceride levels or formation.
